LinkedIn awareness draft exists for internal review only; do not post, tag, or trigger workflows without exact approval.

Internal LinkedIn awareness draft:
$120 million. Unicorn status. Created by the guy who built GitHub Copilot.

Oege de Moor didn't just build Copilot. He understood something deeper: when AI can think like an expert, the hard part isn't the AI — it's protecting the IP that makes the AI work.

His latest move? An autonomous AI that doesn't just find bugs — it thinks like a real adversary. Machine-speed. Continuous.

But here's the question most AI companies haven't answered yet:

Who owns the inventions when the AI is doing the innovating? And can the company later prove which parts were AI-generated vs. human-designed?

For #AI-security: the IP question just got harder. The model is the product. The model's training data is the moat. The documentation of human contribution is the patent.

Educational starting point: AI Patent Strategy Scorecard
